tools.name: recommend_tours
tools.description: Recommend fitting hut-to-hut tours using structured tour data and fresh availability rules. Each result includes `url`, the canonical huettentouren.org detail page — link users there, not to any upstream source.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published hut-to-hut tours by compact public fields. Each result includes `url`, the canonical huettentouren.org detail page — link users there.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch compact, curated details for one published hut-to-hut tour. The returned `url` is the canonical huettentouren.org detail page — link users there.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
